lines: Nobody feels pressure about things they don't *care* about.
Every promotion. Every *deadline.* Every big moment.
#But pressure is what turns coal into *diamonds.*
It's what turns ordinary people into *strong* ones.
#Every time you step into it, you *grow.*
And then you do it anyway.
And the next time, it's a little *easier.*
#The goal isn't to feel no pressure.
To breathe through it. To *focus* through it.
To perform while everything inside you wants to *run.*
That's where the version of you you've been waiting for is *hiding.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: Feeling the Pressure? Good.
post.caption: Pressure means something matters. Walk toward it. 💎
post.first_comment: What's putting pressure on you right now? 👇
